appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Urban Water Supply by Source'.
The y-axis is labeled 'Reported supply share (%)' and has a scale from 0 to 70, marked in increments of 5.
The x-axis lists five source categories: 'Surface water', 'Groundwater', 'Desalination', 'Recycled water', and 'Rain capture'.
The bar for 'Surface water' is blue and has the value '41.2%' displayed above it. It is the tallest bar, extending to approximately 41.2 on the y-axis.
The bar for 'Groundwater' is teal and has the value '29.8%' displayed above it. It is the second tallest bar, extending to approximately 29.8 on the y-axis.
The bar for 'Desalination' is blue and has the value '18.5%' displayed above it. It is the third tallest bar, extending to approximately 18.5 on the y-axis.
The bar for 'Recycled water' is green and has the value '7.2%' displayed above it. It is the fourth tallest bar, extending to approximately 7.2 on the y-axis.
The bar for 'Rain capture' is brown and has the value '3.3%' displayed above it. It is the shortest bar, extending to approximately 3.3 on the y-axis.
